title: 👥 Human Resources Module in Business Central🚀
summary: The Human Resources module in Business Central provides employee management, absence tracking, financial integration for expenses and reimbursements, and reporting capabilities integrated with other modules like Projects and Sales. It covers employee registration, absence registration with multiple matrix visualizations, employee ledger entries for accounting transactions, and standard reports for HR analysis.
key_points: Employee management includes complete cards with personal data, contact information, qualifications, certifications, and assigned items like equipment and vehicles
Absence control tracks absences by cause (vacation, sick leave, personal leave) with analysis matrices by category and period
Financial integration manages advances, loans, travel expenses, and multi-currency payments with automatic posting groups
The module integrates with Resources and Sales modules, allowing employees to link as resources or salespersons
Advanced HR processes like onboarding, performance reviews, time tracking, and employee self-service portals are not included
features: employee ledger entries and payment management
multi-currency support with exchange rate handling
module synchronization with Resources and Sales
